view.name: 视图一致性
view.claim: One program, before and after: the graph the view is asked to present, and the output the program prints, are the same on both sides. The frozen/draft two-reading check that the encoder asks of every graph it encodes is inside this reading: a graph whose two readings disagree is refused, so the case exits differently from the baseline and is counted here.
